analysis_status: deterministic observation-process diagnostic using previously fitted transition-specific detection probabilities; not an independent ecological prediction model

recomputed_from_validated_artifact.role: independent pre-workflow cross-check retained for provenance; superseded as primary validation by validation.workflow_run

exact_identity.persistent_link_specialization: P(observed gain)-P(observed loss)=q_current-q_previous; no period-independence assumption is needed for this difference
exact_identity.product_formula_assumption: the listed product formulas P(G)=(1-q_previous)q_current and P(L)=q_previous(1-q_current), and the corresponding odds-ratio identity, require period-level conditional independence

interpretation.supported: The direction of observed binary changes is strongly aligned with the exact observation-process asymmetry expected when period-level detection probability changes, even under a persistent-latent-link counterfactual.
interpretation.mechanistic_read: The independence-free binary conservation identity shows that a change in marginal observed-presence probability necessarily creates a gain-minus-loss imbalance. For a persistent latent link this imbalance is q_current-q_previous. The fitted Villavicencio diagnostic then shows that observed gain/loss direction is strongly aligned with this detectability axis.
interpretation.important_boundary: The q values use detection probabilities fitted from the same repeated-census dataset, so the AUC is a mechanistic diagnostic of the observation map, not independent predictive validation and not an estimate of the fraction of false rewiring.

not_established: that individual observed gains or losses are false
that the simple fitted detection model is the true observation process
true latent ecological gain or loss
claim_ceiling: The exact identity plus the high diagnostic AUC explains why binary gain/loss direction can track effort and detectability so strongly. It strengthens the rewiring-identification boundary but does not convert detection modeling into a corrected ecological rewiring response.

validation.reproduction: dedicated identity audit step reproduced the frozen AUCs and per-transition values from the same census-rate and two-season-detection surfaces
